This simulation runs from 08:00 to 11:20 today; plan only that window.

blocks.summary: Around 8:45, head to Van Pelt Library's Kamin Gallery to study current exhibits, sketching precedent details and taking notes on form/material for the studio project.

blocks.label: closing
blocks.summary: Return to Meyerson Hall studio by around 10:45 to refine the model with fresh ideas from the lecture and research, wrapping up around 11:20.
